async function craftOneIronSword(bot) {
    // This function attempts to create a single iron sword. It first checks if the sword is already present in the inventory, exiting if it is. It then verifies that the bot possesses at least two iron ingots and one stick. The function searches for a crafting table within a 32-block radius. If a crafting table is found, it proceeds to craft one iron sword. Finally, it confirms that the sword was successfully added to the inventory.
